result.summary: Found 4 issues including a cut-off content card, truncated text, and a labeling inconsistency (discount badge showing -0%).

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating horizontal scroll content is not clearly indicated or the layout doesn't fit properly.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial-card visual cue or fade/gradient edge to indicate scrollable content, or adjust card widths to prevent abrupt cutoff.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis, making it look like a cut-off/broken label.
issues.suggestion: Truncate long restaurant names with an ellipsis (...) to indicate more text exists.

issues.description: The pizza item at the bottom shows a badge reading '-0%' which is a meaningless/broken discount label.
issues.suggestion: Remove the badge if there's no actual discount, or fix the logic so it only displays when there's a real percentage off.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the ramen bar image is white on a light/blurred background, reducing visibility and contrast in some areas of the image.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle background circle behind the icon to ensure consistent visibility regardless of underlying image color.
